title: Enemy Zero
overview:
Your Worst Enemy Is the One You Cannot See.

It begins with the high-pitched sound of danger and ends with the victim's final breath.

An invisible force is slaughtering your entire crew on a ship stranded in deep space. Suddenly all conventional combat skills are worthless as you face your greatest challenge: a silent enemy so brutal, you never see it coming. Plus it's 100 times more deadly than any 3 dimensional foe you've ever met face-to-face.

SSShhhhh. Your ears are your allies now and your gun is your savior.

- As Laura Lewis, you wage mental and physical war with an invisible adversary
- Breakthrough "audio-intuitive" game design and intensely graphic cinematics offer challenging gameplay
- Immersive quality of an RPG strategy game coupled with the intensity of a 1st person shooter
- Chilling Michael Nyman ("The Piano") soundtrack envelopes you in a shroud of mystery and intrigue
